contrastAudit.standard: WCAG 2.x contrast thresholds only; this is not a full WCAG audit
contrastAudit.method: Computed foreground over solid ancestor backgrounds with RGBA alpha composition
contrastAudit.scope: Own text nodes visibly intersecting the captured viewport

thresholds.largeTextDefinition: >=24 CSS px, or >=18.66 CSS px and weight >=700

limitations: CSS background images/gradients are approximated using their computed backgroundColor layers.
